strings.zh: 我在这里抓到凯西了哦,{NEWLINE}让你看看超能系精灵有多厉害！
strings.en: I caught an Abra around here!{SCROLL}Let me show you how awesome Psychic{NEWLINE}types are!

strings.zh: 好不容易躲到这里,{NEWLINE}正准备看看偷到的东西呢,{CLEAR}竟然又冒出你这个碍事鬼来。{CLEAR}看来是有必要灭口了。
strings.en: I finally found a place to hide and was{NEWLINE}about to check out my loot...{SCROLL}And then a pest like you shows up.{SCROLL}Looks like I’ll have to shut you up for{NEWLINE}good.
strings.notes: #1-4: the Rocket burglar from the Cerulean theft case (0460), hiding on this route. #3 zh 说撒 = 说谎 (lie).

strings.zh: 你赢了,你赢了,别打了！{NEWLINE}我把偷来的东西还给你就是。
strings.en: You win, you win! Stop! I’ll give back{NEWLINE}the stuff I stole, OK?

strings.zh: 我们火箭队说撒、欺骗、偷窃,{NEWLINE}那又怎么样？{CLEAR}最终统治世界的一定是我们火箭队,{CLEAR}你就等着那天到来吧！
strings.en: So we Rockets lie, cheat and steal. So{NEWLINE}what?{SCROLL}In the end, Team Rocket will rule the{NEWLINE}world. Just you wait for that day!

strings.zh: 我靠,那个死光头胖子,{NEWLINE}走路都不长眼的吗？{CLEAR}差点把我撞死。
strings.en: Holy crap, that damn fat baldy! Doesn’t{NEWLINE}he look where he’s going?{SCROLL}He nearly killed me.

strings.zh: 终于能两个人单独相处了。{NEWLINE}你能{CLEAR}不打扰我们吗？
strings.en: We’re finally alone together. Could you{NEWLINE}please not bother us?

strings.zh: 什、什么事？{SCROLL}好不容易营造出{NEWLINE}这么好的气氛,{CLEAR}能别烦我们么？
strings.en: Wh-what is it?{SCROLL}We finally got such a nice mood going.{NEWLINE}Could you leave us alone?

strings.zh: 怎么回事啊,那个人！{SCROLL}在华蓝的道馆,{NEWLINE}机器的零件,{CLEAR}在游唦圈的旁边,{CLEAR}这个那个的……{SCROLL}什么乱七八糟的！{NEWLINE}
strings.en: What’s wrong with that guy?{NEWLINE}“Cerulean Gym...near inflatable tube”{CLEAR}is the “Machine Part”?{CLEAR}What was he talking about?
strings.notes: US kept (vanilla Machine Part hint). [User-approved warning review 2026-10-04; exact proposal applied.]

strings.zh: 这里能够抓到凯西喔！{SCROLL}如果我有了凯西的话,{NEWLINE}就能像金黄市的娜姿小姐一样{CLEAR}成为超能力者了吧？
strings.en: You can catch Abra around here!{SCROLL}If I had an Abra, I could become a{NEWLINE}psychic just like Sabrina of Saffron{CLEAR}City, right?

strings.zh: 我早就想去华蓝洞穴看看了,{NEWLINE}无奈那里一直被禁止进入,{CLEAR}这次正好借这个机会去看个究竟。
strings.en: I’ve always wanted to see inside{NEWLINE}Cerulean Cave,{SCROLL}but it’s been off-limits forever.{SCROLL}This is my chance to finally find out{NEWLINE}what’s in there.

strings.zh: 我接到了一封邀请我去华蓝洞穴{NEWLINE}观赏比赛的邀请信。{CLEAR}可是那个洞穴不是一直都禁止进入吗？{CLEAR}到底是谁发出的邀请呢？
strings.en: I got a letter inviting me to watch a{NEWLINE}match in Cerulean Cave.{SCROLL}But isn’t that cave off-limits? Who{NEWLINE}could have sent the invitation?

strings.zh: 哎呀,被你给结结实实地上了一课,{NEWLINE}看来我要走的路还有很长。{CLEAR}不过还是谢谢你陪我对战,{CLEAR}这个送给你吧。
strings.en: Wow, you really taught me a lesson.{NEWLINE}Looks like I still have a long way to go.{SCROLL}Thanks for battling me anyway. Here,{NEWLINE}take this.

strings.zh: 我现在已经拥有了凯西,{NEWLINE}只要假以时日认真锻炼,{CLEAR}就能像金黄市的娜姿小姐一样{CLEAR}成为超能力者了吧？
strings.en: I have an Abra now. If I train hard and{NEWLINE}give it time, I can become a psychic like{CLEAR}Sabrina of Saffron City, right?
